offering_description.value: Designs, manufactures and sells dental products, including implants, orthodontic braces and clear aligners, digital imaging equipment, and dental treatment equipment and consumables. Sells mainly to dentists, dental practices and distributors worldwide.

primary_products.value: dental implants and prosthetics; orthodontic brackets and clear aligners; dental imaging systems and scanners; dental handpieces and treatment units; restorative and endodontic consumables

customer_segment.value: B2B: dentists, orthodontists, dental practices, dental labs, dental service organizations and dental distributors

revenue_model.value: product sales: dental equipment, implants, orthodontic products and consumables sold to dental professionals and distributors

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: manufactures dental implants, orthodontic products, equipment and consumables from purchased materials, sold to dental professionals and distributors; brand owner: markets branded dental products under its own portfolio of brands

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: specialty products (implants, orthodontics) and equipment and consumables (imaging, treatment units, restorative), all for dental professionals

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: dental distributors and dealers worldwide; direct sales: sales to dental practices, orthodontists and dental groups

regulatory_exposure.value: high: dental devices requiring FDA clearance and EU MDR and other approvals, quality system rules
